new_today_news.headline: Darling Ingredients Closes Sale of CTH Sausage Casings Business to SARIA
new_today_news.summary: Darling Ingredients completed the sale of its CTH branded sausage casing business to SARIA on October 5, 2026. The transaction was for an undisclosed amount and is part of the company's strategic portfolio optimization efforts.

new_today_news.headline: Cooking Oil Recycling Center Near Me: Drop-Off, Pickup & Rules
new_today_news.summary: Industry guide distinguishing yellow grease (UCO) from grease-trap waste collection streams, highlighting operational differences and contamination risks. Emphasizes proper segregation of collection streams to prevent service failures.

new_today_news.headline: Akron could avoid $300 million treatment facility under proposed consent decree change
new_today_news.summary: Akron, Ohio is proposing to modify its federal sewer consent decree to avoid a $300 million Enhanced High Rate Treatment facility. Instead, the city would expand wastewater disinfection for two additional months annually (April and November). The city has completed 24 of 26 major projects totaling nearly $1 billion in ratepayer investments.

new_today_news.headline: Clean Harbors to Announce Third-Quarter 2026 Financial Results on October 28
new_today_news.summary: Clean Harbors announced it will release Q3 2026 financial results after market close on October 28, 2026, with a conference call on the same day at 9:00 a.m. ET. The announcement comes after the company completed two major acquisitions in early October.

recent_news.headline: Clean Harbors Completes EnviroServe and ES&H Acquisitions for $775 Million
recent_news.summary: Clean Harbors completed acquisitions of EnviroServe and ES&H for a combined $775 million, funded by available cash and a $600 million senior notes offering. The deals are expected to add approximately $340 million in annual revenue and $87 million in post-synergy adjusted EBITDA.

recent_news.headline: 45Z Clean Fuel Production Credit: 2026 Guide
recent_news.summary: Comprehensive guide explaining Section 45Z tax credits for low-carbon transportation fuels, including biodiesel from UCO. Treasury issued proposed regulations on February 4, 2026, with September 8 emissions rate table update. Credits reach up to $1.00 per gallon for fuels meeting prevailing wage requirements, incentivizing grease and FOG conversion.

recent_news.headline: Shining a Light on Food Waste
recent_news.summary: University-led article on food waste as a sustainability issue, noting that food waste is the single most common material landfilled in the United States. While not industry-specific, it underscores ESG drivers that motivate waste diversion in food service operations.

backfill_news.headline: GFL Environmental Declares Third-Quarter 2026 Cash Dividend
backfill_news.summary: GFL Environmental declared a third-quarter 2026 cash dividend of US$0.0169 per subordinate and multiple voting share, payable October 30, 2026 to shareholders of record as of October 14, 2026.
